title: Crypto go-to-market: how GTM automates content, SEO, and outreach
content_html:
Most crypto teams cannot afford a full marketing department, so visibility becomes a side job that never gets done consistently. GTM is a free go-to-market app that runs that work for you, and it comes with your Cryptool account.

What GTM is

GTM is an always-on go-to-market app. It writes and publishes on-brand posts across your social channels, runs SEO and SEA, tracks brand mentions, and supports outreach, sales, and M&A. It keeps your project visible without a daily content scramble or a new marketing hire.

The problem it solves

  • Content stops the moment the team gets busy building.
  • Nobody has time to run SEO or search ads, so the right people never find the project.
  • Brand mentions go unnoticed, and conversations happen without you.

Hiring an agency or a first marketer is expensive, and it still leaves gaps. GTM covers the always-on work continuously in the background.

What GTM does

  • Publishes on-brand content across your connected channels.
  • Runs search engine optimization (SEO) and search engine advertising (SEA).
  • Tracks where and when your brand is mentioned.
  • Supports outreach, sales, and partnership or M&A motions.

Who it is for

Token projects that need constant visibility without a big team, founders who would rather build than run daily marketing, and teams scaling content, SEO, and outreach at the same time.

Getting started

Open GTM with your Cryptool account, set up your brand, and connect your channels. If you do not have a Cryptool account yet, you can create one free in under a minute.

Try it: https://cryptool.io/gtm
